title: OmenArchive Publication
description: Metadata that identifies and orders one archive publication.

alias.description: The short name files use for this module in effect and type names (core/add-feat).

externalRecords.description: Records that rules refer to but no publication of the archive holds, as canonical omen:// paths. A reference to one of them is not a miss.

spellcastingSources.description: The spellcasting sources the publication's rules name, each by a key in kebab-case after the source's name (ranger-focus-spells), mapped to the source's ID. A rule writes the key as its source; the wire form and the OmenDB store keep the ID.

vocabularies.description: The vocabularies the publication declares, or adds terms to. A vocabulary is a named set of terms that a value of a vocabulary type draws from (a weapon group, a damage type). With extends, the entry adds its terms to a vocabulary a mechanics module declares, written <module alias>/<vocabulary>; the module decides whether its vocabulary is open to other books.

facts.description: The facts the publication's records carry, each declared for a collection. A collection path names every book, so it is declared once for the archive. A record states them under facts.

collection.description: The records the fact belongs to: @, a family, then any folders, joined by dots (@domain, @class.commander.tactics).

type.description: int, bool, the name of a vocabulary, @collection for a reference to a record, or one of these in brackets for a list.

requires.description: The publications this one needs, by id, in a list. A reference, prerequisite or grant that names a record of another publication with ?source= fails without that publication, so it has to be listed here; a record listed in externalRecords is the exception. A link in a description doesn't count, because without its publication a link only loses its target. From format 6.
